text: Hino jeyaa e yimɓe ladde naafiqiiɓe ɓen, on fiɓuɗo wonnde ko o wintotoo kon e jawle fii laawol Alla ngol, ko sooyo, sikkugol wonnde o heɓataa baraaji mun si o wintike, e wonnde o leptirtaake accugol ɗum. e ɗum, himo wintora yiingo e rentaade, o habbitoo nde bone yanata e mon onon gomɗimɓe ɓen, fii no o ɓoortoda e mooɗon. Ko woni tun, Alla waɗii yela maɓɓe bonɗo on nde jamaanu yiilotoo e gomɗimɓe ɓen yanu e maɓɓe kamɓe. Alla ko Nanoowo koɓe haalata, Annduɗo ko ɓe suuɗata.
